products.name: Kimchi Kurrenttt Spread
products.description: A fiery, flavour-packed kimchi spread made for everyday cravings.
descriptionParagraphs: Looking to make your daily dal-chawal more chatpata? Kissan Kimchi Kurrenttt is made with 100% real veggies and spicy chillies. Enjoy Indian heat with a kick of authentic Korean umami flavours in this desi spread.
It is a bold, Korean-inspired spicy condiment that brings together the fresh crunch of vegetables, tangy-spicy chilli flavour and deep savoury umami in a convenient spread.
It can be positioned as an everyday flavour booster for Indian and fusion foods — from roti and paratha to noodles, eggs, sandwiches, wraps and rice bowls.
products.ingredients: Korean cabbage, red chilli, garlic, ginger, spring onion and sesame seeds.

products.name: Fresh Tomato Ketchup
products.description: Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup is made with 100% real, naturally ripened Tomatoes. Pair it with any dish for a delicious meal.
products.ingredients: Water, Tomato Paste# (28%), Sugar, Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulator - E260, Stabilizers - E1422, E415, Preservative - E211, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Spices and Condiments.

products.name: Mixed Fruit Jam
products.description: Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam is a delicious blend of 8 different fruits Pineapple, Orange, Apple, Grape, Mango, Pear, Papaya, and Banana.
products.ingredients: SUGAR, MIXED FRUIT PULP BLEND - 46% (BANANA PULP, PAPAYA PULP, APPLE JUICE, PEAR PULP, PINEAPPLE JUICE, ORANGE JUICE, MANGO PULP, GRAPE JUICE)#, THICKENER- 440, ACIDITY REGULATOR - 330, PRESERVATIVE-202, VITAMIN B3.   CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOUR - 122 AND ADDED FLAVOURS- ARTIFICIAL RASPBERRY, PINEAPPLE AND STRAWBERRY FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES. CONTAINS PERMITTED CLASS II PRESERVATIVE.

products.name: Peanut Butter
products.description: Kissan Peanut Butter contains 100% real Peanuts handpicked from the farms of Gujarat which are perfectly roasted for a smooth and creamy texture.

products.name: Juicy Lemon Squash
products.description: Naturally ripened Lemons, handpicked from the Himalayan Foothills, are used to make our Juicy Lemon Squash.
products.ingredients: Sugar, Water, Lemon Juice (26%), Acidity Regulator - E330, Thickener - E415, Iodised Salt, Antioxidant - E300, Potassium Chloride, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Preservative - E223, Food Colour - E133.

products.name: Chilli Tomato Sauce
products.description: Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce is made with 100% real Tomatoes and spicy Chillies. Enjoy the delicious blend of tangy and spicy in Kissan Chilli Tomato sauce!
products.ingredients: Water, Sugar, Tomato Paste# (22.4%), Chilli Puree (3.8%), Iodised Salt, Acidity Regulator - E260, Stabilizers - E1422, E415, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Preservative - E211, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Spices and Condiments.

products.name: Juicy Grape Squash
products.description: Naturally ripened Blue Grapes, handpicked from the renowned vineyards of Karnataka, are used to make our luscious, Juicy Grape Squash.
products.ingredients: Sugar, Water, Grape Juice (25%), Acidity Regulator - E330, Iodised Salt, Preservative - E211, Potassium Chloride, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Food Colours - (E122, E129, E102, E132).

products.name: Juicy Mango Squash
products.description: Ripe Mangoes, handpicked from the farms of South India, are used to make our Juicy Mango Squash.
products.ingredients: Sugar, Water, Mango Pulp (25%), Acidity Regulator - E330, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Iodised Salt, Potassium Chloride, Preservative - E223 , Food Colour - E110.

products.name: Juicy Orange Squash
products.description: Naturally ripened Oranges, handpicked from the renowned farms of Nagpur, are used to make our Juicy Orange Squash.

products.name: Mango Jam
products.description: Our Mango Jam is made with 100% real Alphonso Mangoes. You don’t have to wait for Summer season to enjoy the taste of our delicious Mango jam!
products.ingredients: Sugar, Mango Pulp# (46%), Thickener- E440, Acidity Regulator- E330, Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Preservative - E202, Food Colour - E110.

products.name: No Onion No Garlic Tomato Sauce
products.description: Our No Onion No Garlic Tomato sauce which is made with 100% real Tomatoes. The taste of the Tomatoes takes centre stage in this one.

products.name: Orange Marmalade
products.description: Our Orange Marmalade is made with Kinnow Oranges. The Zesty Marmalade pairs well with your toast for morning breakfast or a quick evening snack.
products.ingredients: Sugar, Orange Extract# (45%), Glazed Peel (5%), Thickener - E440, Acidity Regulator - E330, Natural Flavouring Substance, Preservatives – (E211, E223), Food Colour - E122.

products.name: Pineapple Jam
products.description: Our Pineapple Jam is made with ripened Pineapples from Kerala. The tropical fruit serves as a perfect balance between sweet and sour for your taste buds.
products.ingredients: Sugar, Pineapple Pulp# (46%), Thickener- E440, Acidity Regulator- E330, Preservatives- (E211, E223), Nature Identical Flavouring Substance.

products.name: Sweet & Spicy Sauce
products.description: Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce is sure to spark your taste buds with the combination of its sweet & spicy taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Methi Roll
recipes.description: Fill your kid’s next tiffin with this quick and tasty Aloo roll.
steps: Heat the oil in a kadhai and add mustard seeds and cumin seeds. When they begin to splutter, add the ginger-garlic paste, and onions and sauté for a few minutes.
Add the chopped fenugreek leaves, capsicum and paneer and cook well.
Add the boiled potatoes, coriander powder, chilli powder and salt and mix well and allow to cook for two more minutes.
Mix in the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and chopped coriander and fry for 2 minutes.
Turning off the stove, add the lemon juice.
Place each roti on the counter and generously spread the hung curds. Once done, add the potato mixture to each roti.
Fold the roti up from the bottom and then fold in the sides to enclose the filling.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Nothing like the smell of some freshly baked Peanut Butter Cookies for a quick protein-filled snack!
steps: In a stainless steel bowl cream butter and sugar using the back end of a wooden spatula.
When whole of the sugar gets incorporated add peanut butter to the mix and cream.
Sieve flour and baking soda together, add dry ingredients to the creamed batter and mix till uniform cookie dough is achieved.
Divide the cookie dough into equal parts, roll into balls using your palm.
Roll in sugar and place on a baking tray maintaining a gap of 1.5” on each side.
Lightly press each piece and bake in a preheated oven at 150⁰C for 20mins.

recipes.name: Quick No-Bake Cookies
recipes.description: Something sweet and energetic to keep handy for your kids at all times. Always keep Kissan No-Bake Cookies handy for an instant energy fix.
steps: In a bowl, crush biscuits to a coarse powder.
Add the muesli, crushed peanuts, sesame seeds and butter and mix well.
Add Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam and mix to make a dough.
Divide the mixture into 6 equal portions and roll into balls. Flatten each ball to make cookies.
Roll the cookies in the dried fruit powder to coat evenly on all sides. Store in an airtight tin.

recipes.name: Oats & Peanut Butter Bar
recipes.description: Looking for a snack packed with Fiber and Protein?
steps: Finely chop the dates.
Pulse the oats in a mixer for 5 seconds (only in case of whole oats).
In a bowl add all the ingredients and mix using a spoon. Use your hands if the mix is not workable with the spoon.
Transfer the mix onto a tray or rectangular baking dish lined with parchment paper or cling wrap.
Place another parchment paper on top and flatten with the palm or a rolling pin to give it a rectangular shape.
Refrigerate for an hour before cutting into rectangular bars.

recipes.name: Whole Wheat & Oats Peanut Butter Pancake
recipes.description: This popular Pancake breakfast recipe has a Peanut Butter twist to it.
ingredients: A few drops of vanilla extract
steps: Blend all the dry ingredients together in a bowl (flour, oats, chia seeds, cinnamon powder & baking powder).
Take the first quantity of banana in a separate bowl and mash with the help of a fork.
Add egg, vanilla extract to the mashed banana and mix. Add milk and stir.
Add the dry ingredients to the liquid mix. Stir till there are no lumps. Add 5g of the melted butter and stir till it is incorporated into the batter.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium flame, grease the cooking surface with oil, if needed.
Pour the batter (1/4rd cup) onto the pan, cook for 2-3mins then flip. Cook further for 2 mins.
Repeat the previous step for the remaining batter.
To serve, in a plate stack 3 warm pancakes with a tsp of Kissan Peanut butter between each pancake.
Place slices of banana on top of the pancakes. Drizzle with honey/maple syrup alternately dust with icing sugar.

recipes.name: Caramelized Bananas with Peanut Butter on Toast
recipes.description: Start your morning with a crispy toast topped with the delicious combination of Peanut Butter and Caramelized Bananas.
steps: Toast the bread slices. Spread Kissan Peanut Butter and set aside.
Heat a pan add butter to it followed by the sugar. Stir often till the sugar starts to caramelize.
Add bananas to the pan and toss to evenly coat it with caramel.
Arrange the banana slices on top of the toast and serve

recipes.name: Peanut Butter & Date Smoothie
recipes.description: Cut back on the sugar-filled smoothies with this delicious smoothie which is a perfect combination of Peanut Butter and Dates.
steps: Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend till smooth.
Pour the mix into a tall glass, garnish with Almond/Roasted Coconut flakes.

recipes.name: Chocolate & Peanut Butter Mousse
recipes.description: Dig into this delightful Chocolately Peanut Butter Mousse recipe.
steps: In a thick bottomed pan heat the cream. Break the chocolate into small pieces.
Turn off the flame as soon as the cream starts to boil. Add chocolate pieces and set aside for 5 mins.
Use a whisk to mix the cream and chocolate, add the peanut butter, and mix further. Allow the mix to come to room temperature.
In a mixing bowl take the required quantity of whipped cream. Fold the peanut butter & chocolate mix into the whipped cream.
To serve: layer the bottom of a glass or dessert bowl with crushed cookies.
Using a piping bag or an ice cream scooper place a scoop of the mousse on top of the cookies, garnish with crushed peanuts and serve.

recipes.name: Spicy Potato Mexican Sandwich
recipes.description: Bet your kids will love this savoury sandwich, especially when you make it with all your love!
steps: Combine the mashed potato, chopped onion, tomato and green in a bowl.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mix well.
Spread butter on the bread slices and then spread with the potato mixture.
Cover with the other slice of bread. Press firmly down and grill on both sides till crisp.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pasta Roll
recipes.description: It’s Italian. It’s Indian. But an instant favourite is what it surely is.
steps: Cook broccoli in boiling water for 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch spinach and puree it, add to the Atta and knead into dough.
Cook the pasta in milk.
Heat olive oil; add finely chopped onion and garlic and sauté till onions turn translucent.
Add broccoli and capsicum and cook on high heat for a few minutes, stirring continuously. Do not overcook the vegetables.
Add oregano, salt, pepper and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup. Stir to mix.
Turn off the heat; add the pasta and mix well. Divide the pasta into 4 equal portions.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll it into chapattis and cook.
Place one portion of pasta on each chapatti and make a wrap.

recipes.name: Tangy Tomato Idlis
recipes.description: When it’s time to take your love for idlis to newer heights, this is how you do it!
steps: Sieve the semolina, urad dal and rice flour together.
Add salt, Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, coconut, green chilli and coriander leaves.
Heat the oil in a small pan and add the tempering ingredients.  When they start to splutter, add the carrots, beans, and spinach. Add the tempered spices to the semolina and mix well.
Stir in the sour yoghurt and mix to make a smooth batter.
Grease the idli moulds with ghee. Heat the water in the steamer.
Add fruit salt to the idli batter and immediately pour the batter into idli moulds.
Steam for 15 minutes. Remove idlis carefully and serve hot with chutney.

recipes.name: Noodle Samosa
recipes.description: Samosas with a refreshing twist to make your kid’s tiffin time exciting and memorable!
steps: For the stuffing, combine the flour, salt and egg in a bowl. Add a little water and knead to make a stiff dough. Cover and set aside for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 3 equal portions.
For the stuffing, heat the oil in a pan; add the cabbage, capsicum and carrot, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the spring onions and sauté for 5 minutes on low heat.
Add the instant noodles with the tastemaker and mix well.
Add the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and cook till the noodles are done.
Divide the mixture into 6 equal portions and set aside.
To make the samosas, roll out each portion of dough into a thin oval chapatti. Cut in half.
Take one half and apply little water on the straight edge. Fold the edge to make a pocket. Fill with the stuffing and seal to make a samosa. Make the rest of the samosas in the same way.
Grease a baking tray and bake the samosas for 15 mins at 180°C
Serve your Kissan Noodle Samosas hot!

recipes.name: Jam Cookies
recipes.description: Here is a small and sweet little treats you can give your kids for their tiffin, so that they finish it completely and get you back an empty tiffin.
ingredients: 3 tbsp Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam (60 g)
steps: Sift both the flours into a bowl and rub the butter with your fingertips. Add the first part of sugar, egg and vanilla essence and mix into a soft dough.
Knead the dough gently on a lightly floured surface until smooth.
Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F/Gas Mark 4. Grease two baking trays.
Roll out the dough thinly on a lightly floured surface and cut into rounds with a two-and-a-half inch cutter. Re-roll the trimmings and cut into more rounds. You should get around thirty rounds.

Place fifteen rounds on a baking tray. With a small three-fourth inch heart-shaped cookie cutter cut out the centers of the remaining rounds. Place the cut-out rounds on the second baking tray. Bake in the preheated oven for about twelve minutes or until pale golden. Remove from the oven and transfer the cookies to wire racks to cool completely.
For the filling, beat together the second part of sugar, cream and strawberries until smooth and creamy. Spread the mixture evenly on the whole cookies. Now, place small mango slices on it.
Spoon a little jam over the cream- mango mix, place the cut-out cookies on top, pressing gently so that the jam fills the heart-shaped space.
The cookies are ready to relish!

recipes.name: Spinach and Potato Roll
recipes.description: So satisfying, your kids will surely ask for more of these hearty rolls in their tiffin!
ingredients: 180 g cut into wedges all-purpose potatoes
steps: Blanch and puree spinach add the pureed spinach to the dough and knead well, divide the dough into 4 equal portions and make phulkas out of it.
Boil the potato wedges in salted water for 2 minutes. Drain.
In a bowl, combine the garlic, crushed peppercorns, chili powder, salt, spinach.
Add the potato wedges and mix.
Drizzle 1 tbsp of oil and bake the marinated potato wedges in oven at 180ºc till crisp. Drain on absorbent paper (or you could air fry the potato wedges in the same manner).
Pour Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup over the wedges and mix well.
Arrange wedges in the center of each spinach phulka and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Chatpata Potato Sandwich
recipes.description: Here’s a guaranteed finger-licking tiffin recipe to give your kids a much-deserved break from the routine of roti sabzi!
steps: Preheat sandwich griller.
Place 2 bread slices on a worktop and apply butter and chutney on one side of each slice. Spread the ketchup evenly on top.
Place the vegetables on bread and cover with other bread slices.
Apply little butter on top of the sandwich and place in the griller. Cook till golden and grill marks appear.
Remove from heat and cut into halves. Serve hot with tomato ketchup.

recipes.name: Quick Fruit Trifle
recipes.description: Presenting fruits in a creative way is the best solution to make your kids' friends with them.
steps: Cut the sponge cake into halves. Place one layer in a glass casserole.

Drizzle two tablespoons of the syrup on it and add half cup whipped cream along with three-fourth cup of chopped mixed fruits on top.  Spread a layer of Jam. Place the other half of the sponge cake on top and repeat the procedure on top.
Sprinkle chopped chocolate on top and refrigerate for one hour.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Corn Omelette
recipes.description: Enjoy the monsoons with these straight-off-the-griddle snacks. You’ll wish the rains to drizzle down all year long
steps: Blend boiled corn to a paste. Transfer to a bowl.
Add cornflour yoghurt and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup to make a batter.
Cover and set aside for at least 30 minutes.
Moisten the bread slices well and add to the corn mixture with salt and pepper powder. Mash the mixture to make a smooth batter. Add a little water if necessary.
Heat a non-stick griddle (tawa) and spread a ladleful of batter to make a thin pancake or omelette.
Drizzle oil around the edges. Cook the omelette on both sides.

recipes.name: Ketchup & Cheese Stuffed Parathas
recipes.description: A quick breakfast recipe that’s got all the yummy reasons for your kids to savour.
ingredients: a pinch of salt and papper
steps: For the filling, combine the cheese, onion, green chilli and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup. Add salt and pepper to taste.
For the dough, combine the refined and wholewheat flours and add enough water to make a dough.
Divide the dough into 2 portions and roll out each one into a small disc. Place half the filling in the centre and bring the edges together to enclose the filling. Roll out again.
Heat a griddle or tawa and cook the parathas on both sides, drizzling a little oil around the edges. Serve hot with Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup or chutney.

recipes.name: French Toast Roll-ups
recipes.description: French Toast with an exciting rolled-up twist.
steps: Trim the crusts from each slice of bread and flatten it with a rolling pin.
Spread with 1 or 2 teaspoons cream cheese and Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam. Roll the bread up tightly.
In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs and milk until well combined.
In a separate shallow bowl, mix the sugar with the cinnamon.
Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat and melt a tablespoon of butter.

Dip each bread roll in the egg mixture to coat it well and place in the pan seam side down. Cook a few at a time until golden brown, turning to cook and brown on all sides, about 2 minutes per side. Add butter to the pan as needed.
Remove cooked rolls from the pan and immediately roll in the cinnamon sugar until completely covered.  Serve at once.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter & Jam Squares
recipes.description: If your kids are bored of regular sandwiches, then here’s what you should do to give it a twist.
ingredients: Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam as required
steps: Break egg in a bowl. Add castor sugar, cream, milk and whisk well.
Spread peanut butter on one bread slice and jam on another bread slice. Put the jam bread on top of the peanut butter bread. Make remaining sandwiches similarly.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan. Dip sandwiches in the egg mixture and place in the pan. Cook on both sides till golden.
Cut into squares and dust icing sugar on top. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese & Jam Sandwich
recipes.description: A sandwich is an all-rounder for kids, but with a wonderful Kissan twist to it, your kids will simply love it even more.
steps: Spread the bread slices with butter.
Mix together the cheese and the Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam and spread evenly over one side of each slice. Sandwich the slices together and cut into triangles.
Heat a grill and place the sandwiches on it. Grill the bread till toasted on both sides and grill marks appear.
Remove and serve hot with Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.

recipes.name: Corn & Mushroom Wrap
recipes.description: Two vegetables that kids love, when put together, make for an interesting and exciting tiffin menu for the day.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan; add the garlic and green chill and fry for a few seconds.
Add baby corn, mushrooms, salt, and pepper powder and fry for a minute.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and stir-fry until the mushrooms are soft.
Place paratha on a work surface and spread baby corn mushroom it.  Sprinkle chopped coriander leaves on top and roll-up.

recipes.name: Spicy Baby Corn Roll
recipes.description: A roll so irresistible that will ensure your kids get home an empty tiffin each time.
steps: For the filling, heat the oil in a non-stick pan; add onion and sauté for 3 minutes. Add mashed potato and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients, except the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, and cook, stirring, for another 2 minutes.
Divide the filling into 4 equal portions.
Spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on each chapatti.
Place one portion of the filling at one end of the chapatti and roll up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining chapattis and filling.

recipes.name: Tangy Tomato Bread Upma
recipes.description: Not many recipes tantalize your taste buds the way this one does. It’s easy to make and even easier to love.
ingredients: 1/4 cup Kissan No Onion No Garlic Tomato Sauce
steps: Chop the bread slices into 2 cm cubes.
In a pan, heat two teaspoons of oil. Add mustard seeds and when they pop, add curry leaves and green chillies.
Add the turmeric and bread cubes and stir-fry on medium heat so the bread is evenly coated with the spices.
Add Kissan No Onion No Garlic Sauce, salt and pepper and mix well.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

recipes.name: Oats Uttapam & Salsa
recipes.description: A powerful breakfast that is rich in nutrition and incredible in its taste. Serve this one hot and see your kids licking their fingers on this one.
ingredients: A few finely chopped coriander leaves
steps: For the salsa, in a bowl, combine chopped onion, capsicum and coriander leaves with 1 cup of Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.
For the uttapam, in a bowl, combine the yoghurt, semolina, oats salt and 1 cup water.
Cover and set aside for 2 hours.
Add the onion, green chilli, tomato and chilli powder to the batter.
Heat a non-stick pan and spread 1 tablespoon batter on it.
Cook on low heat, drizzling oil around the edges. Turn the uttapam over and cook the other side as well. Remove from heat. Prepare the rest of the uttapams in the same way.

recipes.name: Jam Pinwheel
recipes.description: Kids love to eat their tiffin when the food inside looks extraordinary. So try this recipe to make ordinary jam bread look even more delectable.
steps: Slice the bread horizontally into four slices. Remove the crusts from all the sides.
Place each bread slice on the worktop. Spread three tablespoons of Kissan Pineapple Jam evenly on it. Sprinkle the chopped pineapple.
Roll up each bread slice and wrap it up tightly in a cling film. Refrigerate the rolls for fifteen to twenty minutes.
Cut the bread roll into one-inch thick roundels and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Bread Pizza
recipes.description: A simple and quick pizza recipe to pack in your kid’s next snack box.
ingredients: Salt & black pepper powder for taste
steps: Heat oil in a deep non-stick pan. Add onions and ginger-garlic paste. Mix well and sauté for a minute.
Add cloves and mix well. Sauté till onions turn brown. Add chopped tomato and mix well.
Add tomato ketchup, sugar, cardamom powder, salt and black pepper powder. Mix well and cook till thick.
Apply butter on both sides of the bread slices and place on a heated non-stick pan. Cook slices till brown from both the sides.
Apply the tomato sauce on one side of the bread slices. Place a cheese slice on each bread slice covering the sauce. Cover and cook for five to six minutes.
Cut into desired shapes and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chapatti Chaat
recipes.description: Wondering what to make of leftover chapattis? Try this simple twist and get yourself a completely new recipe.
steps: Cut the chapattis in 2-inch triangles.
Heat the oil in a pan and deep-fry the chapatti triangles. Drain on absorbent paper.
Arrange the fried chapatti in a plate. Top with the chopped boiled potato and sprinkle the onion, green chili and whisked yoghurt.
Place dollops of Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mint chutney on top and sprinkle over with the sev and chopped coriander leaves.
Give leftover chapattis a new lease of life with chatpata Kissan Chapatti Chaat.

recipes.name: Chapatti Noodles
recipes.description: Add a delightfully spicy chapatti twist to your regular noodles.
steps: Stack the chapattis one on top of the other and cut into thin, long strips.
Heat the oil in a pan; add the crushed garlic, onion and green chilli and sauté for a minute.
Add the sliced vegetables and stir-fry for a minute.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, pepper powder and salt and stir to mix.
Add the sliced chapatti and toss well on high heat to mix thoroughly.
Garnish with the chopped spring onion and serve immediately.
Leftover chapattis get a spicy makeover in Kissan Chapatti Noodles.

recipes.name: Cheese & Jam French Toast
recipes.description: Give your regular french toast such a twist that your kids will find no reason to not eat it.
steps: Break egg in a bowl. Add castor sugar, cream, milk and whisk well.

Spread peanut butter on one bread slice and jam on another bread slice. Sprinkle cheese on the peanut butter. Put the jam bread on top of the peanut butter and cheese bread. Make remaining sandwiches similarly.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan. Dip sandwiches in the egg mixture and place in the pan. Cook on both sides till golden.
Cut into triangles and dust icing sugar on top. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Barley & Spinach Rolls
recipes.description: Kissan Barley and Spinach Rolls pack a powerful energy and flavour punch.
steps: Heat the oil or butter in a non-stick pan; add onion and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes till lightly browned.
Add boiled spinach and barley, mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup, salt, pepper and cream, and cook till spinach is completely dry.
Spread the mixture on the chapattis or parathas and roll up tightly.
Slice each roll into 1-inch pieces and serve.

recipes.name: Chilli-Milli Mayo Rolls
recipes.description: Our Chilli Tomato Ketchup is the best way to make rolls even more flavourful.
steps: In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce and garlic.
In another bowl, mix together the red and yellow capsicum, green and purple cabbage, carrot and mint.
Add the vegetables to the mayonnaise mixture and toss well to mix.
Lay a lettuce leaf in the middle of each chapatti and spoon some of the vegetable mixture on top. Roll up the chapatti. Repeat with the remaining ingredients.

recipes.name: Boiled Egg & Ketchup Sandwich
recipes.description: To make those sandwiches for tiffin time much yummier, try out this recipe!
steps: Spread half a teaspoon of butter on a slice of bread.
Spread half the tomato ketchup on top, followed by half the shredded lettuce.
Arrange slices of 1 boiled egg on top.
Butter another slice of bread on both sides and place it on top of the egg.
Repeat the layers ending with a slice of bread. Cut the 3-layered sandwich into 2 triangles.

recipes.name: Uttapam Sandwich
recipes.description: Taking a regular Uttapam to newer levels of awesome. Your kids will love this interesting variation.
steps: Heat a griddle (tawa) and grease it with little oil.
For each uttapam sandwich, pour a little batter on the griddle to make a small uttapam.
When the uttapam is half cooked, add vegetable toppings, sprinkle with salt and drizzle oil on top.
Cover the griddle with a lid and cook for 2 minutes; turn the uttapam and cook for a minute.
Cook three small uttapam of the same size.
Spread 1 tablespoon of green chutney on the first uttapam, place the second uttapam on top, and spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup. Place the third uttapam on top.

recipes.name: Jam & Peanut Sandwich
recipes.description: With a unique combination of exciting flavours, your kids can never have enough of this.
steps: To make peanut butter masala, heat the butter in a frying pan; add the peanuts and sauté till golden brown.
Add the salt and sugar and cook for a minute.
Remove from heat and grind to make a coarse mixture.
Spread the peanut butter masala on a slice of bread.
Top with shredded lettuce and cover with another slice of bread.
Spread Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam on top and cover it with the last slice.
Cut the triple-layered sandwich into 2 triangles and serve with French fries.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich
recipes.description: A classic paneer sandwich recipe to beat your kid’s random hunger pangs!
steps: Heat the oil in a pan; add the chopped onions and fry until they turn pink.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala and salt, and mix well.
Add the paneer and mix gently. Sauté until the spices coat the paneer.
Spread a little butter on a slice of bread. Top with 2 tablespoons of the paneer mixture. Cover with another slice of bread.
Cook Kissan Paneer Tikka Sandwich on both sides on a tawa, or grill until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Vegetable Toasties
recipes.description: Make tiffins special with the greatly satisfying toasties.
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce
steps: Mash the boiled potatoes, onion and carrot together in a bowl.
Add the garam masala, pepper and chilli powder and mix well.
Spread the butter on one side of each slice of bread.
Spread the potato mixture on one slice. Cover with another slice, press down lightly and trim the edges. Make another sandwich in the same way.
Place in a sandwich toaster and toast till crisp.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with Fried Egg
recipes.description: Spaghetti is always a fun dish to eat for kids. With Kissan’s twist to it, it makes it even better!
steps: Heat the butter in a pan and fry the onions till brown.
Add the chilli powder and mushrooms and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and capsicum and fry for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spaghetti and salt, stir well to mix and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer to a dish and place the fried eggs on top.
Sprinkle with cheese and serve piping hot Kissan Spaghetti with Fried Eggs as a complete meal.

recipes.name: Soya Stuffed Parathas
recipes.description: A perfect vegetarian alternative to the famous keema parathas.
steps: Mix together the wholewheat flour and a little salt in a bowl. Add sufficient water and knead into a dough. Cover and rest the dough for some time.
Place soya granules in a bowl; add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and the rest of the ingredients, except ghee, and mix well.

Divide the dough into small portions and shape them into balls. Roll out each one into a small disc and place a little of the soya granule mixture in the centre. Bring the edges, together to enclose the filling and shape into a ball again.
Roll out the dough dusting with a little flour.
Heat a non-stick tawa and cook the parathas on both sides, drizzling a little ghee around the edges. Cut each parantha into four pieces and serve hot.

recipes.name: Garlic Chicken Wings
recipes.description: You don’t need to wait to go to a restaurant to enjoy delicious chicken wings. With this Kissan recipe, it can now be a scrumptious tiffin meal for you kid!
steps: Melt the butter in a pan. Add the garlic and cook until light brown.
Stir in the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and cook for 2 minutes
Add the Tabasco sauce and simmer for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add the chicken wings and egg and mix well to coat the wings. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oil in a pan. Roll the wings in the breadcrumbs and fry them till golden. Drain on absorbent paper.
Then pour your prepared sauce over the cooked chicken wings and toss for 2 mins.
Heat any remaining marinade in a small pan and pour over the wings.

recipes.name: Stuffed French Bread
recipes.description: A crusty and crunchy delight that is filled with cheese and mushrooms. There is so much to love!
steps: Cut the loaf of bread horizontally. Scoop out the soft bread out of each half and set aside.
In a large pan, cook the garlic, mushrooms, onion and green capsicum over medium heat for 2 minutes.
Beat the cream cheese with the oregano. Stir in the mushroom mixture.
Spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup in the scooped out loaf; fill with mushroom mixture. Cover with the top half of the loaf, press down lightly and wrap in foil.
Place on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated hot oven for 5-10 minutes, or roast on a tawa. Leave to cool for 5 minutes.
Slice crusty, crunchy Kissan Stuffed French Bread into thick slices to reveal its cheesy mushroom filling.

recipes.name: Sweet Buns
recipes.description: Enjoy these stuffed Kissan Sweet Buns as a tiffin snack or with a cup of tea.
steps: Cut each sweet bun horizontally in half. Apply butter on both cut sides and toast on a griddle (tawa), or in a hot oven till crisp.
In a bowl, mix together grated coconut, tutti-frutti, Kissan Pineapple Jam and cinnamon powder.
Spread 1-2 teaspoons of coconut filling on the bottom half of each bun and cover with the top half.
Place in a hot oven and toast for 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Idli Jam Candy
recipes.description: A quick and easy recipe for times when your kid wants to indulge in something sweet.
steps: Spread Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam on both sides of the idlis.
Fasten the idlis onto the toothpicks.
Roll the jam-coated idlis in the dried fruit.
Kissan Idli Jam Candy is sweet indulgence in one bite.

recipes.name: Chatpate Rolls
recipes.description: This recipe will help you make your rolls look so much more appealing. What better way to complement its taste.
steps: Grind the green chillies, coriander leaves, lemon juice and salt to make.
Trim the crusts from the bread slices. Using a rolling pin, roll out each slice.
Spread butter on one slice, spread chutney on the second slice, and Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam on the third slice.
Place the chutney slice over the buttered slice and the jam slice on top.
Roll up the stack tightly and secure in cling wrap or a piece of muslin. Make another roll in the same way.
Refrigerate the rolls for 10 minutes.
Cut the rolls in slices and serve them, cut side down, to reveal the pinwheel pattern.

recipes.name: French Fry & Cheese Wrap
recipes.description: A blend of two cuisines, packing a punch in one simple roll! This makes for the perfect quick recipe.
steps: Heat the chapattis on a frying pan or griddle and spread with butter.
Arrange the salad leaves on the hot chapattis and arrange French fries on the lettuce.
Spread Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on top, and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Roll up tightly to enclose the filling and serve.

recipes.name: Omlette & Potato Rolls
recipes.description: Quick, simple and easy rolls that taste delightful!
steps: Lay a paratha on a work surface. Spread half the Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on the paratha and arrange half the potato slices on top.
Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a pan and pour 1 beaten egg into the hot oil.
Cook for 1 minute, turn over and sprinkle with 2 teaspoons grated cheese. Cook for 30 seconds or until set.
Place the omelette on one paratha. Top with 1 teaspoon cheese and a dollop of ketchup. Roll up to enclose the filling and serve immediately. Repeat with the remaining egg and paratha.

recipes.name: Mango & Mint Salsa Rolls
recipes.description: Here’s another exciting way to serve mangos to your kids every summer.
steps: In a bowl, combine Kissan Mango Jam, mint and chaat masala.
Add the mango cubes and mix gently.
Spread the mixture on each roti or paratha and roll it up.
Serve up some summer freshness in Kissan Mango Mint Salsa Rolls.

recipes.name: Masala Scrambled Eggs Wrap
recipes.description: Very simple to make, and delicious in the tummy! Try this one out soon.
steps: Heat the butter in pan and fry the chopped onion till soft.
Add the green chillies and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and  fry for a few minutes
Add the eggs and stir to mix.
Add salt, fresh cream and coriander leaves. Cook, stirring, till the eggs are cooked but the mixture is still moist and creamy.
Spread the scrambled eggs on the chapatti, top with sliced capsicums and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Masoor & Sweet Potato Rolls
recipes.description: Now with this roll, you don’t have to worry about ensuring your kids get their dose of required nutrition.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and add the cumin seeds. When they crackle, add the onions and sauté till they turn semi-transparent.
Add the green chillies and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the mashed sweet potato, boiled red lentils, chaat masala, coriander and salt, and sauté for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mix well. Divide the mixture into 4 equal portions.
Place a portion of hot spicy potato and lentil filling in the centre of each chapatti and roll up lightly.
Place the rolls on a hot griddle (tawa) and cook using a little oil, till the rolls turn golden brown.

recipes.name: Methi Thepla Ketchup Rolls
recipes.description: How about treating your kids with a yummy roll this weekend! Try and let us know how it was.
steps: Place the gram flour in a bowl; add the fenugreek leaves, spring onion, coriander leaves, green chilli, curd, salt and pepper. Add enough water and make a soft dough.
Divide the dough into 4 portions and roll each one out into a disc.
Heat a little oil in a frying pan and cook each disc on both sides.
Place some aloo jeera in the centre and spread a teaspoon of Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup on top.
Roll up tightly and serve hot with coriander and mint chutney.

recipes.name: Sago Patty Rolls
recipes.description: Crisp patties in soft chapatis! Now that’s a combination you should definitely serve your kids.
ingredients: A small bunch of finely chopped coriander (dhania)
steps: Wash and soak sago in cold water for 1 hour.
Finely chop the ginger and green chillies, or grind them together to a paste.
In a bowl, combine the drained sago, cooked bottle gourd, ginger, green chillies and chopped coriander.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mix well.
Shape equal portions of the mixture into medium patties. Heat the oil and deep-fry the patties till golden. Remove and drain on absorbent paper.
Spread green chutney on each chapatti. Place a patty on each chapatti and roll it up.

recipes.name: Samosa Wrap
recipes.description: Samosas can get messy to handle in a tiffin. Making simple wraps out of them makes for not just a mess-free tiffin, but also something that your kids will enjoy eating.
steps: Place each paratha on a plate and place a mashed samosa on top.
Sprinkle over with onion green chilli and whisked yoghurt.
Top with dollops of Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and mint chutney.
Sprinkle with chopped coriander and roll the paratha up.

recipes.name: Stir-fried Cabbage And Peanut Rolls
recipes.description: We feel your kids will definitely start loving vegetables when they are served in this fashion.
steps: Heat oil in a pan; add mustard seeds and peanuts and fry till mustard seeds splutter.
Add the curry leaves, green chilli and onion, and fry till the onions turn golden brown. Add the turmeric powder and stir to mix.
Add chopped cabbage and salt and mix well. Add ¼ cup water and cook, covered, for 5 minutes. Stir in Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and coriander leaves and mix well.
Cook till cabbage is tender and remove from heat; leave to cool for a few minutes.
Add coconut to this and mix well.
Place the filling on the chapattis and roll-up. Serve with Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.

recipes.name: Tawa Aloo Chaat Roll
recipes.description: For your potato loving kid, here’s a delicious Aloo Chaat roll you can whip up for tiffin today!
ingredients: 2 tbsp Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce
steps: Combine the black salt, ginger paste, chopped onions, sugar and lemon juice mix well.
Coat the potatoes with the mixture and set aside for 10 to 15 minutes.
Heat the oil on a tawa; add the marinated potatoes and stir-fry till golden brown.
Add Kissan Sweet and Spicy Sauce, green chilli and chaat masala and sauté for 2 minutes.
Spread some potato mixture on each chapatti and sprinkle with coriander leaves. Roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Paneer Jammy Croquettes
recipes.description: A perfect recipe for a surprise tiffin. Make a lot of them as your kids will make new friends over it!
steps: In a bowl, combine the grated paneer, Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam and the rest of the ingredients except oil, adding the breadcrumbs and cornflour at the end.
Shape the mixture into round croquettes or cutlets.
Mix a little cornflour with water to make a thin paste.
Roll the croquettes in the paste then roll in breadcrumbs.
Heat the oil in a kadhai till it starts smoking.  Slide a few cutlets/croquettes at a time into the oil and fry till they are golden brown and crisp on all sides. Drain on absorbent paper.

recipes.name: Tutti Frutti Bread & Marmalade Pudding
recipes.description: A special way to end a special dinner that you’ve cooked for your children.
steps: Butter both sides of each slice of bread and spread with half the Kissan Orange Marmalade. Sandwich 2 slices together and cut into triangles.
Whisk the eggs and sugar till light and fluffy. Stir in the milk, cream and vanilla essence.
Soak the bread in the egg mixture for 20 minutes.
In a baking tray, arrange the sandwiched triangles in a single layer. Pour the leftover egg mixture over the soaked bread.
Spoon the remaining Kissan Orange Marmalade over the top.
Bake in a preheated oven at 140°C/275°F/Gas 1 until the bread puffs up and starts to caramelize.

recipes.name: Mango & Banana Smoothie
recipes.description: The next time your kids ask you for a dessert, make this simple smoothie for them.
steps: Place Kissan Mango Jam together with the rest of the ingredients in a blender and blend till smooth.
Serve ice cold. Ready in a jiffy, Kissan Mango and Banana Smoothie is the perfect pick-me-up.

recipes.name: Coconut & Jam On Bread
recipes.description: A simple tiffin with a jammy twist! Will your kids enjoy this treat?
steps: Heat the butter in a pan; add the coconut and fry for a few seconds.
Add the milk and bring to a boil.
Add the breadcrumbs, cashew nut powder, Kissan Pineapple Jam and cook, stirring, till the mixture is thick. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
Spread the topping on the bread and decorate with dollops of jam.
One bite of Kissan Coconut and Jam on Bread and you will be whisked off to a tropical island.

recipes.name: Sweet Apple Slices
recipes.description: Something light and tasty to counter the mid-day snack worries.
steps: Coat the apple slices with Kissan Mixed Fruit Jam.
Roll them in the muesli and top each with a small dollop of peanut butter.
Crunchy Kissan Healthy Apple Slices – light bhi, tasty bhi.

recipes.name: Sweet & Spicy Corn Bhel
recipes.description: What better than our local favourite bhel to accompany the pouring rain. But our version takes it a notch higher.
steps: In a bowl, mix together the corn, onions, potatoes, 1 tablespoon chopped coriander and Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce.
Garnish with sev and the remaining coriander and serve.

recipes.name: Sweet & Spicy Brinjal
recipes.description: Without this simple recipe, your kids would’ve never known how tasty brinjals can be.
ingredients: 1 large brinjal, cut into thick slices
steps: Place the brinjal slices in a colander. Sprinkle salt and chilli powder on both sides of the slices, and leave to drain for at least 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place the yogurt in a strainer set over a bowl to drain.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and fry the brinjal slices till soft. Remove and drain on absorbent paper.
Heat a little more oil in the same pan; add the chopped onion, ginger, green chillies and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Arrange the brinjal slices in a plate; spread the onion mixture on top, followed by the drained yogurt. Sprinkle with coriander leaves.

recipes.name: Soya Burger
recipes.description: A wonderful twist to make an unhealthy fast food healthier for your child’s tiffin.
steps: Soak soya granules in two cups of milk for fifteen minutes.  Drain and squeeze out extra milk. Grind to make finer granules.

In a large mixing bowl, mix together soya granules, mashed potatoes, onion, green chillies, coriander leaves, cumin powder, red chilli powder, lemon juice and salt.  Add two tablespoons ketchup and mix.
Divide mixture into four equal-sized balls. Shape each ball into a patty of three inches diameter and about half-inch thick.
Coat each patty evenly with breadcrumbs.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook the patties on both sides till crisp.

Halve a burger bun.  Apply the mustard paste on the base half and the remaining tomato ketchup on the top half.  Place two to three lettuce leaves on the base half.  Place the patty on this, top with onion rings, cover with the top half of the bun and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mini Pea & Paneer Parathas
recipes.description: Start your week on a delicious note! We really think your kids will love these yummy Peas and Paneer parathas.
steps: Combine all the ingredients, except ghee, in a bowl and knead into a soft dough.
Cover and set aside for a few minutes.
Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and roll out each portion into a 3-inch disc.
Heat a non-stick pan and cook each paratha on both sides, brushing it with half a teaspoon ghee.

recipes.name: Vermicelli Cutlets
recipes.description: Make this as your next patty whenever you are planning to make delicious burgers for your kids.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Add ginger paste and fry for 1 minute.
Add grated carrot and green peas and cook till tender.
Add all the spice powders and salt and stir well.
Add the cooked vermicelli, chopped coriander and mashed potato.
Add the Kissan Chilli Tomato Sauce and mix well. Shape portions of the mixture into desired shapes.
Place a griddle (tawa) on medium heat and drizzle a little oil on it.
Fry the cutlets on the griddle until both sides turn crispy and light brown.

recipes.name: Dahi Tikki
recipes.description: A scrumptious snack that is royal in taste. Make sure you prepare plenty of them.
steps: Place the yoghurt in a piece of muslin or cheesecloth and drain the liquid completely for about 5-6 hours.
Heat ½ tablespoon oil and fry onion and ginger until soft.
Add the rest of the ingredients, except cornflour and Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and stir well. Remove from heat and leave to cool.
Stir in Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup.
Divide the mixture into small balls and flatten them slightly to make tikkis. Coat the tikkis with cornflour.
Heat the remaining oil in a non-stick frying pan. Fry the tikkis till golden brown on both sides.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chinese Spicy Finger Rolls
recipes.description: Chinese is an all-time favourite with kids, right? Have you made this for them yet?
steps: Chop all the vegetables very finely. Add salt and set aside for 5-10 minutes. Squeeze out the excess water.
Add the cornflour, green chilli paste and salt to the vegetables and mix well.
Divide into small portions and shape each one into a 2-3 inch finger.
Heat the oil in a kadhai and deep-fry the fingers till golden and crisp. Drain on absorbent paper.
For the sauce, heat the oil in a pan; add the chopped garlic and fry for 1 minute.
Add Kissan Fresh Tomato Ketchup and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add the fried Chinese fingers to the sauce and mix well.
Place a portion of the mixture on each chapatti and roll it up.
